name: Follow Your Heart Cafe
note: OpenStreetMap said "08:00-21:00"; the shop's own source wins. Read: Our Hours & Address / MARKET Daily 9AM - 9PM / CAFÉ Daily 10:30AM - 8PM / BRUNCH Saturday, Sunday & Select Holidays 9AM - 3PM / 21825 Sherman Way Canoga Park 91303 The café's hours, not the market's.
